import Mathlib.Tactic
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace PV_L2C_InverseChain

def chain {M : Type} [Monoid M] (x : M) : M :=
  let t2 := (x*x)*x
  let t4 := t2^(2^2)*t2
  let t8 := t4^(2^4)*t4
  let t16 := t8^(2^8)*t8
  let t24 := t16^(2^8)*t8
  let t28 := t24^(2^4)*t4
  let t29 := (t28*t28)*x
  let t30 := t29*t29
  (t30*t30)*x

/-- The frozen 38-multiplication chain is checked symbolically; no concrete
field inverse or generated recurrence is normalized. -/
theorem exponent {M : Type} [Monoid M] (x : M) : chain x = x^2147483645 := by
  have h2 : (x*x)*x = x^3 := by simp [pow_succ]
  have h4 : (x^3)^(2^2)*x^3 = x^15 := by rw [← pow_mul,← pow_add]
  have h8 : (x^15)^(2^4)*x^15 = x^255 := by rw [← pow_mul,← pow_add]
  have h16 : (x^255)^(2^8)*x^255 = x^65535 := by rw [← pow_mul,← pow_add]
  have h24 : (x^65535)^(2^8)*x^255 = x^16777215 := by rw [← pow_mul,← pow_add]
  have h28 : (x^16777215)^(2^4)*x^15 = x^268435455 := by rw [← pow_mul,← pow_add]
  have h29 : (x^268435455*x^268435455)*x = x^536870911 := by
    rw [← pow_add,← pow_succ]
  have h30 : x^536870911*x^536870911 = x^1073741822 := by rw [← pow_add]
  unfold chain
  rw [h2,h4,h8,h16,h24,h28,h29,h30,← pow_add,← pow_succ]
#print axioms exponent
end PV_L2C_InverseChain

import PV_L2C_SamplerFill
import PV_L2C_SecureGuard
import PV_L2C_PaddingNative
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace PV_L2C_SampledSecure
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result PV_L2C_NativeQ PV_L2C_StateSampler PV_L2C_PaddingNative

def table (values : List Q) : Fin 1024 → Q := fun r => values[r.val]!

theorem sampled {S : Type} (next : S → Result (PV_L2C_M31.word × S))
    (fuel : Nat) (s s1 : S) (values : List Q)
    (h : PV_L2C_SamplerFill.fill (secure next fuel) 1024 s = ok (.ok values,s1)) :
    ∀ r : Fin 1024, Canonical (table values r) := by
  obtain ⟨hl,hc⟩ := PV_L2C_SamplerFill.secure next 1024 fuel s s1 values h
  intro r
  have hr : r.val < values.length := by rw [hl];exact r.isLt
  apply hc
  rw [table,getElem!_pos values r.val hr]
  exact List.getElem_mem hr
#print axioms sampled

def column (active : Fin 1024 → Bool) (d : Fin 1024) (values : List Q) : Nat → Q :=
  fun r => if h : r < 1024 then rebalance active d (table values) ⟨r,h⟩ else zero

theorem guard {S : Type} (next : S → Result (PV_L2C_M31.word × S))
    (fuel : Nat) (s s1 : S) (values : List Q)
    (h : PV_L2C_SamplerFill.fill (secure next fuel) 1024 s = ok (.ok values,s1))
    (active : Fin 1024 → Bool) (d : Fin 1024) :
    PV_L2C_SecureGuard.loop 1024 0 (column active d values) = ok (.ok ()) := by
  apply PV_L2C_SecureGuard.column
  intro r hr hr'
  unfold column
  rw [dif_pos (by omega)]
  exact rebalance_canonical active d (table values) (sampled next fuel s s1 values h) _
#print axioms guard

theorem audit {S : Type} (next : S → Result (PV_L2C_M31.word × S))
    (fuel : Nat) (s s1 : S) (values : List Q)
    (h : PV_L2C_SamplerFill.fill (secure next fuel) 1024 s = ok (.ok values,s1))
    (active : Fin 1024 → Bool) (d : Fin 1024) (hd : active d = false) :
    PV_L2C_QFold.tableSum (PV_L2C_QFold.inactiveTable active (rebalance active d (table values))) = zero :=
  raw_sum_zero active d (table values) (sampled next fuel s s1 values h) hd
#print axioms audit
end PV_L2C_SampledSecure

import PV_L2C_SamplerFill
import PV_L2C_RouteBaseGuard
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace PV_L2C_SampledBase
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result PV_L2C_M31 PV_L2C_StateSampler
abbrev Cell := PV_L2C_MaskRange.Cell

theorem attached (cells : List Cell) (values : List word)
    (hc : ∀ v ∈ values, canonical v) : ∀ cm ∈ cells.zip values, canonical cm.2 := by
  induction cells generalizing values with
  | nil => simp
  | cons c rest ih =>
    cases values with
    | nil => simp
    | cons v values =>
      intro cm hm
      rcases List.mem_cons.mp hm with he | ht
      · cases he;exact hc v (by simp)
      · exact ih values (by intro v hv;exact hc v (by simp [hv])) cm ht
#print axioms attached

def applySampled {S : Type} (next : S → Result (word × S)) (fuel : Nat)
    (bank : PV_L2C_MaskRange.Bank) (cells : List Cell)
    (active : Fin 1024 → Bool) (dependent : Fin 16 → Usize) : Step S PV_L2C_MaskRange.Bank :=
  bind (PV_L2C_SamplerFill.fill (scalar next fuel) cells.length) (fun values =>
    pure (PV_L2C_MaskRange.balance (PV_L2C_MaskRange.applyCells bank (cells.zip values)) active dependent))

theorem returned {S : Type} (next : S → Result (word × S)) (fuel : Nat)
    (bank : PV_L2C_MaskRange.Bank) (hc : PV_L2C_MaskRange.Canonical bank) (cells : List Cell)
    (active : Fin 1024 → Bool) (dependent : Fin 16 → Usize)
    (s s1 : S) (out : PV_L2C_MaskRange.Bank)
    (h : applySampled next fuel bank cells active dependent s = ok (.ok out,s1)) :
    ∀ c, PV_L2C_BaseGuard.check (PV_L2C_RouteBaseGuard.column out c) = .ok () := by
  unfold applySampled at h
  obtain ⟨values,after,hv,h⟩ := bind_returned _ _ _ _ _ h
  cases h
  obtain ⟨hl,hcan⟩ := PV_L2C_SamplerFill.scalar next cells.length fuel s s1 values hv
  intro c
  exact PV_L2C_RouteBaseGuard.bank_expected _
    (PV_L2C_MaskRange.application bank hc _ (attached cells values hcan) active dependent) c
#print axioms returned
end PV_L2C_SampledBase
